reviewer_notes: Arithmetic and budgets are clean: every recommended price is under the stated ceiling, and every weight gap (400g, 600g, 0.35kg), all-in pen cost (85,000 + 8,000 = 93,000) and battery or export figure matches the evidence. The two number flags are false positives. B001's '16 wh' is 'SlimDev-16, whose' and B016's '7 wh' is 'engine E7, while'. The weaknesses are structural. (1) 24 of 25 evidence rows use one template: two options, one record each, and in 13 rows the loser simply fails a hard gate (x64 only, data-only USB-C, no CUDA, memory error), so the model can pass by spotting the failed test. There are no close calls with 3–4 options, no honest NO-MATCH rows and no conditional (F8) answers, although S3 is where 'it depends on your version or setup' matters most. (2) The citations are bare 'R1/R2/C1' with no [ID] brackets, and the evidence has no catalogue IDs, no n owners and no recency (D6). 'R1' is not unique across rows, so citation placement can't be checked by code. (3) Language: B001, B012 and B023 are Hinglish queries with English replies (D3). (4) Three rows are outside India (B006 GBP, B017 USD, B020 EUR); the spec allows at most 1. (5) Coverage gaps against the spec: no Tally/GST, MATLAB, Android Studio, Revit or local-AI rows. Linux has 1 row, the proctoring app is fictional and appears once, and India-specific peripherals (DSC token, thermal printer) are missing. (6) A bias toward paying more: 17 of 24 picks are the pricier option, and most sit within ₹1,000–₹6,000 of the ceiling. Only B012 and B014 test 'don't pay for what you don't need'. (7) All 125 assertions are typed semantic. Every '.1' budget or price check and every 'Does not fabricate' line is deterministic or partly deterministic (D2). There is no language assertion, and every row repeats the same generic '.5' anti-fabrication line.

rows.proposed_ideal: LedgerPro-W (₹98,000) is the one to buy: RiskPlug 7 is Windows x64 only and your employer prohibits remote access (C1), so SheetLite-M can't run it. R2 shows a large workbook with RiskPlug 7 recalculating in 21s on LedgerPro-W; that's the reviewer's workbook, so yours may differ as it grows. R1 found SheetLite-M responsive for ordinary spreadsheets, but RiskPlug wasn't tested. Looks are a fair tiebreaker only once the add-in works. Next step: confirm with IT that your RiskPlug version is 7 and the image they'll install, before ordering.
